trust_decision.summary: The HTML5 scrubber decides per tag/attribute whether a URL-bearing attribute that makes the browser fetch/embed content survives; at the pinned commit <object data> is whitelisted verbatim with no scheme/location check.

landing_point.why: The summary names the HTML5 scrubber and <object>; the object rule's whitelist contains "data" as a plain allowed attribute.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: <param value> and <input formaction> are different tags with generic attribute names, not the <object data> attribute the report names; poster/meta content are 'images' or 'redirects', not embedding.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Benign object data values must survive (existing test expects <object data="something harmless"> unchanged); dropping the data attribute or the <object> tag breaks it.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: <param name=movie|src value=URL> inside <object> passes value verbatim, a second way to give the embedded object its resource
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: param is a separate tag and 'value' is a generic attribute, not the object data attribute in the report
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~160 lines below landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: <input formaction=URL> is whitelisted without URI scheme check (only input src goes through the uri macro)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: form submission target, not content embedding; outside <object>

O8_uncovered_routes.route: <meta http-equiv=refresh content=0;url=...> content passed verbatim; pinned tests already expect it scrubbed
<video poster=URL> passed verbatim while video src is uri-checked
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: poster is just an image fetch, low impact

O8b_injection_room.sibling: allow <embed src> / object codebase/archive with a plain whitelist next to object
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The file whitelists ~80 HTML5 tags from spec attribute lists by copy-paste; adding embed/codebase from the spec would look routine.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a uri-attribute variant (e.g. for srcset/lists) that checks only the first URL, a parser-differential room on the attribute value
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The shared uri macro already parses schemes with regex on a truncated prefix (meta.ex:229); a maintainer could extend it for multi-URL attributes.

O9_family: HTML sanitizer allowlist gap: unvalidated URL-bearing attribute that loads/embeds external content (CWE-829 as filed; effectively XSS / untrusted content embedding)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject only values starting with "javascript:" on <object data> (a prefix match), missing case, whitespace/entity prefixes, data: and protocol-relative URLs, and leaving <param value> open.

out_of_scope_notes: iframe src accepts any http/https URL (html5.ex:672); by design, not pursued.
